data.summary:
* Moved `audio.stored` Pub/Sub publish into `ProcessAudioMessageUseCase.execute()` so a publish failure now marks the webhook event `failed` (with `failureDetails` and an `audio_publish_failed` structured log) instead of silently dropping the transcription trigger.
  * Aligned `ecosystem.config.cjs` whatsapp-service topic fallbacks with Terraform-managed `intexuraos-*-dev` names (was `audio-stored-dev`, `approval-reply`, `commands-ingest`, `whatsapp-webhook-process`, etc. — all non-existent in GCP).
  * Split `BasePubSubPublisher.publishToTopic` into strict `string` + `publishToOptionalTopic(string | null)` variants; made `audioStoredTopic` and `approvalReplyTopic` non-nullable in `GcpPubSubPublisher` with a runtime guard; migrated bookmarks-agent, actions-agent, commands-agent, and prTriage publishers to the optional helper before narrowing the signature.
  * Tests: new failure-path tests in `processAudioMessage.test.ts` assert the use case returns `err(...)`, webhook event becomes `failed`, and GCS/Firestore rows are preserved for retry; `webhookAsyncProcessing.test.ts` audio case reasserted for the new `failed` outcome; `pubsubPublisher.test.ts` asserts constructor throws on missing required topics.
  * CI: `pnpm run ci:tracked` passes (15,226 tests, all 20 static checks); PR https://github.com/pbuchman/intexuraos/pull/1906 open against development.
